Add technical assessment to your campus hiring process
Codility Screen runs asynchronous engineering assessments for graduate applicants.
Your campus platform manages relationships and outreach; Screen provides task results your recruiters can use for evaluation.
Choose a shortlist that fits your interview capacity
Manual review becomes difficult when applications exceed the interviews your engineers can conduct. Screen lets recruiters invite a cohort in bulk and score selected tasks automatically. Codility connects with platforms, including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SAP and SmartRecruiters.
The score distribution helps your team review a proposed cut score before selecting candidates. Your recruiters make the shortlisting decision.
The difference:
Your team can plan interviews using the cohort’s demonstrated ability and the time available.

Refresh assessment content between cohorts
Reusing the same questions can give later cohorts access to shared solutions. Task randomization and larger item pools help you vary the assessment. You can rotate content between cohorts, and Codility removes leaked tasks from the library.
Similarity Check provides evidence of overlapping submissions for a reviewer to inspect. Codility does not automatically disqualify a candidate on an integrity signal.
Your team has content controls and reviewable evidence when students share assessment material.
Find drop-off and review the effect of your cut score
A final hiring count cannot explain where students left the process. Campaign analytics show invitations, starts, completion, score distribution and time usage. Your team can identify parts of the assessment that need closer review before the next season.
Codility’s assessment team runs
adverse impact analysis
on its own task library as part of validation work. Analysis of your own campaign data is available through a specific engagement rather than as a standard report.
You can support the end-of-season review with assessment data.

Frequently asked questions
Campus recruiting software supports employers hiring students and recent graduates. Relationship tools manage outreach and events, while technical assessment tools evaluate engineering ability. Codility provides the assessment part of that process.
No. A campus recruiting platform manages student relationships. A technical assessment platform evaluates candidates through tasks and results your hiring team can review.
Yes. Recruiters can send bulk invitations, use automatic scoring on selected tasks and track completion for the cohort.
Thirty to forty-five minutes across one or two tasks is
Codility’s recommendation for early-career assessments
. Review time-usage data against your cohort’s experience.
Task randomization, content rotation and larger item pools help reduce repeated exposure. Codility also removes leaked tasks. These controls reduce risk without guaranteeing that no questions will be shared.
No. Your team makes the hiring decision. Codility’s scoring is deterministic, so the same submitted output receives the same score.
Yes, when you enable the AI Assistant for the assessment. Every interaction is captured as reviewable AI activity for your reviewers.
Codility runs adverse impact analysis on its own task library as part of assessment validation, and can analyze your campaign data through a specific engagement. Candidate feedback provides a separate view of the assessment experience; satisfaction is not evidence that adverse impact is absent.
Codility integrates with applicant tracking platforms including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SAP and SmartRecruiters. Review your campus workflow with Codility to confirm the required connection.
